oracleBindings.role: Test-only Audit Result conformance oracle (strict parse, schema evaluation, semantic ValidateDocument) consumed by the M1 audit CLI checker; pinned by SHA-256 in protectedInputs as the guard.

meta.reconciliationGate: Pins and canonical fixtures are regenerated when the accepted #35 baseline merges or when the shared oracle changes, in the same coordinated change or an immediately following reconciliation change; until then the checker enforces the pinned baseline. Run classification depends only on auditOutcome values.

parseCases.note: Input extensions are matched ASCII case-insensitively.
The output value contains a control character.
An empty equals value is classified as a missing value.
A token beginning with -- is never consumed as a space-form value.

pathCases.note: Relative roots are resolved against the process working directory as argument preprocessing.
Dot segments are normalized before confinement evaluation.
An existing ancestor is a reparse point that resolves outside the resolved root.
In-repository output is rejected in P0 before invalidation.
The resolved parent must be outside the resolved root.
The resolved parent is outside the resolved root; the deterministic rule evaluates resolved paths.
A final symlink is never followed and never replaced.
The parent must pre-exist; the CLI creates none.
The output can never alias a confined input or policy path.

resultValidationCases.note: Artifact-version rejection: the auditResultVersion integer is unsupported.
The contract-baseline/provenance identity in the host terminal record is missing or mismatched; fail-closed per the draft lifecycle. Baseline identity lives outside the canonical Audit Result bytes.

cli.cancel.requested: a cancellation signal was received; cancelling

streamCases.stdout: Canonical Audit Result bytes appear only at --output, atomically published; they never appear on any stream.

terminalLifecycleCases.sequence: P4a non-success commit, then crash before envelope emission
P4a non-success commit, then stdout write failure
P4b atomic result replacement, then crash before envelope emission
P4b atomic result replacement, then stdout write failure
Crash after run-start invalidation before either applicable commit
OS launch, runtime-load, or permission failure before run-start invalidation completes
Managed bootstrap failure before run-start invalidation completes
Prior output locked or unremovable while the process remains alive
Cancellation accepted during invalidation before any commit
Crash, abort, or kill during invalidation

cancellationCases.note: Repeated signals do not escalate and never change the selected class.
A signal after commit is an external observation.
Help, version, and doctor invocations have no cancellation behavior.

forbidden: timestamps, durations, or process IDs in envelopes
